text: Professional Overview: Foreign Languages and Literatures belong to the discipline of humanities and social sciences, covering the study of foreign linguistics and foreign literature. It is the product of the exchange and cultural interaction between Chinese and foreign civilizations. Its research subjects include foreign language studies, foreign literature studies, translation studies, country and region studies, comparative literature and cross-cultural studies.Training Objectives: Based on solid foreign language skills and literary and cultural cultivation, students will be trained to have the ability to comprehensively read foreign languages, promote the mutual learning of Chinese and Western cultures, enhance their critical thinking and appreciation skills, and strengthen their awareness of international expression of Chinese culture and wisdom.Main Courses: Include basic corresponding languages, advanced corresponding languages, selected readings of newspapers and periodicals, audio-visual materials, oral communication, corresponding language writing, translation theory and practice, language theory, introduction to linguistics, selected literary histories and literary works of major corresponding countries, and the national conditions of major corresponding countries.Secondary Disciplines: There are 11 secondary discipline specialties, namely English Language and Literature, Russian Language and Literature, French Language and Literature, German Language and Literature, Japanese Language and Literature, Indian Language and Literature, Spanish Language and Literature, Arabic Language and Literature, European Language and Literature, Asian and African Language and Literature, and Foreign Linguistics and Applied Linguistics.Employment Directions: Graduates will mainly work in foreign affairs, trade, culture, publishing and printing, education, research, tourism and other departments, engaging in translation, research, teaching, and management.
